// diagnostic

L0202

Auto-clone `Shared` inside loop (lint)

What

Auto-clone `Shared` inside loop (lint)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for L0202

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0202: tests/ui_lint/shared_loop.warn.

Warning [L0102] (unused_parameter): parameter `h` is never used.
  --> tests/ui_lint/shared_loop.jet:1:9
    |
  1 | fn noop(h: Shared<Int>) { print(0) }
    |         ^
 Why: an unused parameter often means the function contract or implementation is incomplete; Jet keeps this warning-only so prototypes stay unblocked.
 Fix: use `h`, rename it to `_h` when it is intentionally unused, or remove it from the function contract.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0102

Warning [L0202] (shared_auto_clone): auto-cloned `h` inside a loop; consider hoisting or caching
  --> tests/ui_lint/shared_loop.jet:4:18
    |
  4 |     loop -> noop(h)
    |                  ^
 Why: shared handles are cloned when used across a loop boundary
 Fix: hoist `h` before the loop, or clone once outside
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0202

Warning [L0104] (unused_private_fn): private function `loop_user` is never called or used as a value.
  --> tests/ui_lint/shared_loop.jet:3:4
    |
  3 | fn loop_user(h: Shared<Int>) {
    |    ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: a private function with no reachable reference is dead code; public functions stay exempt because other modules may use them.
 Fix: remove the function, or rename `loop_user` to `_loop_user` when it is intentional.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/L0104
